GUJARAT GOVERNMENT GAZETTE EX,. 1I-05-20}:
[PAri".['-i-ri
1. These rules may be called the Gujarat Village Panchayats Election (Manner of Allotment of
Reserved Seats by Rotation) (Arnendment) Rules, 2012.
2. In the Gujarat Village Panchayats Election (Manner of Allotment of Reserved Seats by
Rotation) Rules, 1994, to rule 11, the following proviso shall be added, namely:-
"Provided that where population of Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes, as the case may b!,
exists in the area of any village Panchayat, at least one seat each shall be reserved for Scheduled Castes .
and Scheduled Tribesr' as the case may,!e, lor such village Panchayat even if, fraction is less than one half
in value".
By order and in the name of the Govemor of Gujarat,
NRV.A.r{ S}XAI{,
Deputy Secretary to Governrnent.
Government Central Press, Gandhinagar.
